archetypes.name: migration-cohesion
archetypes.rationale: The plan simultaneously removes mtime-touch callers, adds install-stamp writers, and changes sort ordering — each touching the same version-dir retention contract. A mixed-state cache (some dirs stamped, most legacy un-stamped) will exist on first upgrade, and the plan's stamp-presence-first sort is the only protection; this reviewer checks whether that invariant is watertight.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every caller of `lib-larch-cache-touch.sh` in the file list (session-setup.sh, write-session-env.sh, write-design-current-env.sh) and verify the plan accounts for all of them. Check whether the stamp-write and the prune call are atomic enough that a crash between them cannot leave the cache inconsistent. Verify that the stamp-presence-first sort in `list_cached_versions_by_install_stamp` provably prevents any legacy un-stamped dir from displacing the just-installed stamped dir during the first upgrade run. Confirm the already-latest path's `ACTUAL_VERSION` binding happens strictly before the shared prune call in the plan, and identify any code path that could reach prune with `ACTUAL_VERSION` unset. Check whether the plan removes every reference to the deleted helpers (`collect_active_session_versions`, `warn_preserved_active_version_once`, `version_gt`, `sort_versions`, `LARCH_UPGRADE_FALLBACK_SESSION_ROOTS`) from all files in the change surface, not just `upgrade-larch.sh`. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-wiring
archetypes.rationale: The plan creates a new test file (test-cleanup.sh/md), updates many existing harnesses, deletes two scripts, and requires Makefile + agent-lint.toml changes — but the plan text only loosely specifies which Makefile prerequisite list receives test-cleanup and whether agent-lint.toml exclusions are updated for each deleted/added file.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each test file added or modified in the plan, verify that the plan text specifies a concrete Makefile prerequisite list (`test-harnesses-N`) where the new target lands, and that the `.PHONY` addition is listed. Check whether `agent-lint.toml` is updated for both the newly created `skills/cleanup/scripts/test-cleanup.{sh,md}` pair and the two deleted files (`lib-larch-cache-touch.sh`, `lib-larch-cache-touch.md`), confirming the plan removes stale allowlist entries rather than leaving orphaned rows. Verify that each edge case enumerated in the plan's Edge Cases section maps to at least one explicit test case in the Testing Strategy section, and flag any edge case (e.g. stamp write failure combined with exactly-8-cap, or depth-2 grandchild freshness during `/cleanup`) that appears in the plan body but has no corresponding test assertion. Check that `test-session-env-roundtrip.md` section references (F/G/H) are not merely described as removed but that the harness `.sh` assertions they correspond to are also removed in the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
